description: DTP Managed Roads is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department of Transport and Planning. This data informs which major roads in Victoria are classified as freeways, arterial roads and non-arterial state roads. ‘DTP Managed Roads’ are roads which are managed by DTP on behalf of Head, Transport for Victoria who is the Coordinating Road Authority under the Road Management Act 2004. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Department of Transport and Planning . Its tags are arterial, freeway, non-state arterial, road. It offers 1 resource(s) in GEOJSON. The portal shows 2026-03-18 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
